en: It hides widespread use and familiarity.

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a very mature ecosystem with lots of tools, extensions, and plug-ins for whatever you need to add, whether it be observability, networking, security.
zh: 它是一个非常成熟的生态系统，拥有大量工具、扩展和插件，可以满足你想要添加的任何东西，无论是可观测性、网络还是安全。

speaker: Unknown
en: It helps maintain services with their built-in safe healing, load balancing and auto-scaling that keeps everything running smoothly.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: They can SSH with their user.

speaker: Unknown
en: And now to them, it's a Slurm cluster with all the bells and whistles that they need.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't need to set up an entirely new infrastructure stack, new observability tools, new on-call teams, new runbooks, nothing like that.

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all built into the same thing.

speaker: Unknown
en: It runs alongside all your other services.

speaker: Unknown
en: And resources in Slurm, so any jobs, make use of the built-in topology-aware scheduling.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is an overview of what exactly happens when AutoClusters detects a critical hardware error, in this case an XID79 error, where one of the GPUs is completely unusable.
zh: 这是 AutoClusters 检测到严重硬件错误时具体发生的事情的概览，在这个案例中是一个 XID79 错误，其中一块 GPU 完全不可用了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the first thing that happens is that the user is notified, although there's no action required from them.
zh: 那么发生的第一件事是用户收到通知，尽管他们不需要采取任何行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then the slurm operator sets that specific node to down and cancels any running jobs.
zh: 然后 slurm operator 将该特定节点设置为 down，并取消所有正在运行的作业。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's then a, the process receives a sigterm signal before being terminated and you have up to two minutes to handle that sigterm to either save your checkpoints or flush your logs before that node is eventually replaced.
zh: 然后有一个，该进程在终止前会收到一个 sigterm 信号，你有最多两分钟的时间来处理那个 sigterm，可以保存你的 checkpoint 或刷新你的日志，之后该节点最终会被替换。

speaker: Unknown
en: The cancel job is automatically re-queued.
zh: 被取消的作业会自动重新排队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then auto clusters start.
zh: 然后 auto clusters 启动。

speaker: Unknown
en: So first it verifies that no pods on the node have a label that disables automatic replacement.
zh: 首先它验证该节点上没有任何 pod 带有禁用自动替换的标签。

speaker: Unknown
en: Assuming that node can be replaced, the Kubernetes node is then cordoned and drained.
zh: 假设该节点可以被替换，Kubernetes 节点随后会被 cordon 和 drain。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the unhealthy node is removed from the node pool and replaced with a new healthy node from spare capacity.
zh: 然后那个不健康的节点会从节点池中移除，并用来自备用容量的新健康节点替换。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then a record of the alert and the remediation is logged for the user's reference, but there's still no action required from them.
zh: 然后该警报和修复的记录会被记录下来供用户参考，但他们仍然不需要采取任何行动。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then once that healthy node comes back online, then the slurm job starts, your application code runs to load your model and load your checkpoint and resume training.

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right is the Crusoe Cloud Console where I have a GPU node pool of two A100 nodes.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm going to launch this as normal and then what I'm going to do is run a script

speaker: Unknown
en: To tell our backend internal monitoring system that there's been an XID79 error on one of the GPUs.
zh: 来告诉我们的后端内部监控系统，其中一个 GPU 上出现了 XID79 错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this will trigger auto-clusters.
zh: 这会触发 auto-clusters。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we can see immediately the GPU utilization drops.
zh: 这样我们能立即看到 GPU 利用率下降。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we know that that GPU has gone offline and auto-clusters node replacement starts immediately.
zh: 于是我们知道那个 GPU 已经下线，auto-clusters 的节点替换立即开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the full process from detecting a critical hardware error to getting a healthy node back into the node pool takes roughly five minutes with auto-clusters.
zh: 而使用 auto-clusters，从检测到严重硬件错误到把一个健康节点重新纳入节点池的完整过程大约需要五分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: The rest of the time is mainly application-level code.
zh: 其余时间主要是应用层面的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so in this example, it's a little under 15 minutes from end to end.
zh: 在这个例子里，端到端总共用了不到 15 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: And here I'm just showing some of the alerts that the user receives when there's a critical hardware error like this.
zh: 这里我只是展示当出现这样的严重硬件错误时用户收到的部分警报。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so as you'll see,
zh: 正如你将看到的，

speaker: Unknown
en: There's no action required from the user.
zh: 用户不需要执行任何操作。

speaker: Unknown
en: The slurm job will restart.

speaker: Unknown
en: It'll load the checkpoint and continue training where it left off.
zh: 它会加载检查点，并从上次中断的地方继续训练。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we can see the GPU utilization returns back to normal.
zh: 我们可以看到 GPU 利用率恢复正常。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the total downtime is less than 15 minutes.
zh: 总停机时间不到 15 分钟。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is much better than having an engineer have to log on in the middle of the night and spend hours debugging something.
zh: 这比让一名工程师不得不在半夜登录并花几个小时调试问题要好得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of this is handled automatically on our platform.
zh: 所有这些都在我们的平台上自动处理。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now historically, creating this type of environment has been challenging to merge both Slurm and Kubernetes.
zh: 从历史上看，创建这种类型的环境一直很难将 Slurm 和 Kubernetes 合并起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we're really excited to announce what we call one-click Slurm, where everything that we've talked about in this presentation, this entire environment can be provisioned with just a single command.
zh: 所以我们非常高兴地宣布我们称之为 one-click Slurm 的东西，在这个演讲中我们谈到的所有内容，整个环境只需一条命令就能完成配置。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this one command includes provisioning the underlying Kubernetes cluster, the Slurm controller, login nodes, and storage.
zh: 这一条命令包括配置底层的 Kubernetes 集群、Slurm 控制器、登录节点和存储。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then adding a GPU node pool is only one command beyond that.
zh: 而在此基础上，添加一个 GPU 节点池只需要再加一条命令。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this means that engineers can simply SSH in and start running jobs immediately, and AutoClusters is enabled by default.
zh: 这意味着工程师只需 SSH 进去就可以立即开始运行作业，而且 AutoClusters 默认是启用的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So wrapping up, what we covered, starting with the limitations of traditional Slurm, it gives you the high performance job scheduling, but not the automated healing that modern AI infrastructure requires.
zh: 总结一下，我们讲的内容：从传统 Slurm 的局限性开始，它提供高性能的作业调度，但缺乏现代 AI 基础设施所需的自动修复能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so by building Slurm on top of Kubernetes, we can enable these advanced features without having either team change their workflows.
zh: 通过在 Kubernetes 之上构建 Slurm，我们可以在任何一方的团队都不改变工作流的情况下启用这些高级特性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we covered the full node remediation flow from an error being detected to the Slurm job resuming and the training resuming.
zh: 接着我们讲了完整的节点修复流程，从检测到错误到 Slurm 作业恢复、训练恢复。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the key takeaways here, first is that traditionally Slurm and the infrastructure that it runs on are two separate systems, but together with Kubernetes,
zh: 这里的关键要点：第一，传统上 Slurm 和它运行所在的基础设施是两个独立的系统，但与 Kubernetes 结合之后，

speaker: Unknown
en: Both systems stay in sync, and so a failed GPU node can get cordoned automatically, and that signal will propagate directly to the Slurm operator.
zh: 两个系统保持同步，因此一个故障的 GPU 节点可以被自动封锁（cordon），该信号会直接传播到 Slurm operator。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, like I mentioned earlier, neither the platform teams nor the machine learning teams have to change their workloads.
zh: 另外，就像我之前提到的，无论是平台团队还是机器学习团队都不必改变他们的工作负载。

speaker: Unknown
en: Researchers can still use the same commands to launch Slurm, and although Kubernetes is running underneath, researchers never have to SSH into a pod or worry about containers.
zh: 研究人员仍然可以使用相同的命令来启动 Slurm，虽然 Kubernetes 在底层运行，研究人员永远不需要 SSH 进一个 pod 或操心容器。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the Kubernetes teams still get access to the same level of telemetry and observability that they're used to.
zh: 而 Kubernetes 团队仍然可以获得他们所习惯的同等水平的遥测和可观测性。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then lastly, like Nikhil mentioned, the GPU nodes are Kubernetes nodes first, and that means that Slurm is just a workload running on top, and when a Slurm job finishes, those GPU nodes don't have to sit idle waiting for another job.
zh: 最后，就像 Nikhil 提到的，GPU 节点首先是 Kubernetes 节点，这意味着 Slurm 只是运行在其上的一个工作负载，当一个 Slurm 作业完成时，这些 GPU 节点不必闲置等待下一个作业。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can schedule inference pods on those immediately through Kubernetes, because from the platform's perspective, they're still just nodes in a pool.
zh: 你可以通过 Kubernetes 立即在它们上面调度推理 pod，因为从平台的角度看，它们仍然只是节点池里的节点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the core idea here is that failures are inevitable.
zh: 所以这里的核心思想是：故障是不可避免的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so in today's AI landscape, the architecture of infrastructure should be designed in a way so that when there is a critical error, all the right actions are handled autonomously and engineers can focus on building their application and not worrying about the infrastructure.
zh: 在当今的 AI 格局中，基础设施的架构应该被设计成：当出现严重错误时，所有正确的操作都自主完成，工程师可以专注于构建他们的应用，而不用担心基础设施。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hopefully this was an informative talk.
zh: 希望这是一个有信息量的演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have any questions, feel free to connect with us at boothug12 or on social at crusodev.
zh: 如果你有任何问题，欢迎在 boothug12 展位或社交媒体 crusodev 上与我们联系。

speaker: Unknown
en: And thank you for listening and feel free to ask any questions.
zh: 感谢各位的聆听，欢迎随时提问。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thanks.
zh: 谢谢。
